review: The hymn is the love of God in the cross: the chorus is Rom 5:8 with Titus 3:5 and Ps 23:2; 1:1–4 is Rom 5:7–8 with Eph 2:13, 2:1–4 is Ps 32:1 with Col 2:13–14, and 3:1–4 is Ps 34:9 (טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ) with John 7:37.

The chorus stands first, as the print marks it [القرار] before the numbered stanzas; the payload keeps it as a labelled chorus-stanza rather than repeating it after each verse, since the book prints it once.

3:2 טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנָי quotes Ps 34:9 word for word, the psalm the Arabic وَذُوقُوا وَانْظُرُوا الرَّبَّ is quoting; the imperative pair is kept as the psalm's invitation and not softened to 'consider'.
